why: Substantial 2024-2025 progress (Xie-Yuan, and Gao Nov 2025) proves cases of the geometric Bombieri-Lang conjecture over function fields for varieties admitting finite maps to abelian varieties, but this is the function-field/geometric analogue, not the number-field statement Wikipedia's bullet asks about; could not confidently tell whether these papers' results are read by experts as bearing on the arithmetic conjecture stated here.
